verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents recurring vendor-run services: auto-filing of annual reports, deadline reminders, compliance notifications and mail-scan alerts. These are fixed managed services, not user-configurable automations an AI-native user can define to run on their own in the background. They are adjacent features and earn no credit. Nothing in the pack shows user-defined workflows, triggers, or agentic automation setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
